method: Manual transcription checked against primary publisher HTML/PDF table text through web tools. Original download bytes were not obtained; these are verification excerpts, not original source files.
scope: National aggregates only. No residual groups, subnational polygons, estimates of missing data or renormalization.

tables.definition: Usual residents, all ages, at most two ancestry responses. Denominator includes not stated. Ancestry is not ethnicity, race, citizenship or birthplace.
